rules.logic: ABIOC(AV and EDR Product Discovery via tasklist Piped to findstr in a Loader Lineage) AND (XQL(extrac32 Unpack and Renamed AutoIt3 Interpreter Execution Surfaced) OR XQL(Loader Stager Fetch and Lumma C2 Egress on the Network Plane)) on the same agent_hostname within the correlation window — fuses the real endpoint loader-lineage signal (the security-software-discovery burst and the benign extrac32 CAB unpack) with the network stager-fetch / Lumma C2 egress into ONE Lumma-loader incident spanning the EDR and NDR planes.
